C1392.title: Mirai Co-Author Paras Jha Sentenced to Home Confinement and $8.6 Million Restitution
C1392.summary: In October 2018, a U.S. court sentenced Paras Jha for DDoS attacks against Rutgers University, ordering $8.6 million in restitution and home confinement. The Department of Justice identified Jha as a co-author of the Mirai botnet malware; the judgment demonstrates accountability for botnet-enabled disruption of university network services.
